messages:
Elaine (CSM): Quick heads up — CrescentData (mid-market, ~120 seats) showing ~35% W/W usage drop, renewal in 28 days. Concerned about churn. Proposing a short save plan + downgrade intercept. @Sam can you pull last 3 weeks of active seats & top 3 failing flows?

Sam: On it. Pulling now — will post numbers in ~15m. Quick q: do we want to try a product workshop + usage credit, or a pricing credit? Leaning workshop first.

Jordyn: From onboarding notes: they never enabled streaming responses and stuck to small batch runs. P0: move them to lighter seq settings + enable prefix-caching — should show immediate cost drop. Also noticed bulk calls coming from `reporting-worker` svc.

Matthew: Recommend two-track save: (A) enable feature workshop + 2-week advisory with CSM engineer; (B) downgrade path that preserves KV caches and model pins (no data loss). If they opt for B we offer a 20% ramped credit for 2 months. Timeline: outreach today, workshop by EOW, decision within 2 weeks.

Priya (CS Manager): Draft checklist for the save play:
- 1) Exec email + POA (Elaine)
- 2) Tech triage + quick config changes (Jordyn)
- 3) Workshop invite + agenda (Sam)
- 4) Offer promo credit if still sliding (Matthew)
- 5) Track outcome in success-play tracker and flag renewal (cs-bot)
Please add times/PRs and confirm owners.

Elaine (CSM): Outreach copy (sending now):
```
Hi <Name>,
We've noticed a sustained drop in usage and wanted to understand what's changed. Could we run a 45min hands-on workshop this week to optimize your runs and reduce tokens/costs? We'll also share a short cost-impact plan.

Thanks,
Elaine (CSM)
```
If anyone has tweaks please drop inline.

Sam: Seat counts: active seats 98 -> 64 over 3 weeks. Top failing flows: `daily-batch-report`, `ad-hoc-embed`. Sending workshop invite for Wed 10am PT.

Jordyn: Quick config snippet I'll apply during triage:
```sh
# reduce max_seq and enable prefix cache
redwoodctl config set --org crescentdata --model-defaults 'max_seq:1024,prefix_cache:true'
```
I'll stage a canary rollback in case of perf regressions.

cs-bot: Automated reminder created: renewal_alert:CrescentData scheduled at 2 weeks before renewal.

Priya (CS Manager): Owners and deadlines:
- Outreach/exec email: Elaine (today)
- Tech triage & config: Jordyn (tomorrow)
- Workshop facilitation: Sam (Wed 10am PT)
- Escalation/discount approval: Matthew (as needed)
Update the playbook doc after each step: /docs/cs/saveplays/crescentdata — I'll own final review.

Elaine (CSM): Thanks team. I'll post a short outcome update after the workshop and we can decide downgrade vs save. :thumbsup:
